<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def piece_bbox(frame):
    for n in frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in ('p','W') and 15 <= n['pixels'] <= 200:
            b = n['boundary']; rs=[p[0] for p in b]; cs=[p[1] for p in b]
            if min(rs) < 20: continue
            if min(rs)>=33 and max(rs)<=45 and min(cs)>=26 and max(cs)<=38: continue
            return (min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs))
    return None
# currently at B. Press RIGHT to go to A, then keep pressing RIGHT to map clockwise orbit.
seq = []
for i in range(9):
    action(['RIGHT'])
    bb = piece_bbox(current_frame)
    seq.append(bb)
    if current_frame.step - 22 > 12: break
print('positions after each RIGHT from B:')
for i,bb in enumerate(seq): print(i+1, bb)
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
